solution: Identify the names starting with J: Jane, Jamie, Jazz (3 people).
Treat these 3 people as one block.
Now we have 6 units (1 block + 5 other individuals).
Arrange the 6 units in a circle: (6 - 1)! = 5! = 120.
Arrange the 3 J’s within their block: 3! = 6.
